paid_market_gaps.gap: Buyers must assemble approved VPN, disk encryption, hardware and integrator; demand for single-source, ready-to-use bundles
BSI explicitly seeks more providers for supply security; few notebook bundles, dominated by secunet and genua
Approved clients listed mainly for Windows 10/8/7; little choice for Mac, Linux or modern OS fleets
Regional police tender for up to 6,000 VS-NfD clients re-published repeatedly, suggesting a hard-to-fill procurement

wtp_evidence: 2021 Bundeswehr framework for the whole SINA product family ~EUR 874M over four years; secunet public-sector revenue EUR 412M in 2025; state police tendering up to 6,000 approved clients; BSI seeks more suppliers.
bundling_note: VS-NfD use requires product-specific BSI approval; no OS or cloud vendor ships an approved VPN/disk-encryption stack free, and native BitLocker has no such approval.
summary: Real, large government spend, but a regulated oligopoly (secunet, genua/Bundesdruckerei, Rohde & Schwarz) behind multi-year BSI approvals. Only openings: integration/managed-service layer on approved components for Länder, police and classified-contract SMEs; not a new-product startup.
